name: nonApi_recordRunEmailSent
description: Records that a run email went out (E9.F6.S8). For @kind 'send': bumps HC.Event.EmailSendCount, stamps EmailLastSentAt and EmailLastSentCount (the Event updatedAt trigger fires, so the run re-syncs to phones), and when @saveInstruction = 1 stores @instruction on HC.Kennel.RunEmailInstruction as the kennel's default drafting instruction (blank clears it). For every kind ('send', 'preview', 'announcement') writes one LOG.GeneralLog row (LogSource 'RunEmail', StrParam1 = event id, Data = JSON {kind, sender, recipients, subject, audit, movedIn, movedOut}) for the audit trail and the Usage Data 'Email' row; 'preview' and 'announcement' log only. Called by the RunEmail API endpoint after the send was handed to the mail service — internal only, no device auth. @recipientCount is required (THROW ⇒ caught ⇒ Success 0 envelope, logged); @eventId is required for a send. Since 2026-10-13 the Event update, kennel instruction update and LOG.GeneralLog insert run in one transaction.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The run. Required when @kind = 'send' (else the envelope says 'eventId is required for a send'); may be NULL for an announcement. Default NULL.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The sender, for the log line and HC.ErrorLog.userId. Default NULL.

parameters.name: recipientCount
parameters.description: How many addresses the send went to. Required: NULL ⇒ Success 0 'recipientCount is required'. Default NULL.

parameters.name: instruction
parameters.description: The drafting instruction used; stored on the kennel only when @saveInstruction = 1 and @kind = 'send'. Trimmed; blank ⇒ NULL (clears). Matches the column (NVARCHAR(500)). Default NULL.

parameters.name: saveInstruction
parameters.description: 1 = store @instruction as the kennel default. Default 0.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: 'send' (default) | 'preview' | 'announcement'. Only 'send' touches HC.Event / HC.Kennel; any other value logs with the 'Run email sent' message but writes nothing else.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: The email subject, logged (LEFT 200) in the JSON. Default NULL.

parameters.name: auditPath
parameters.description: Blob path of the audit copy (EmailAudit container), logged. Default NULL.

parameters.name: movedIn
parameters.description: Recipients the admin moved IN for this send (audience overrides), logged. Default 0.

parameters.name: movedOut
parameters.description: Recipients the admin moved OUT for this send, logged. Default 0.

parameters.name: sendId
parameters.description: The composer's id for this send (E14.G2.R5, 2026-10-14), stored in the GeneralLog row's Data JSON. A send with an id already recorded for this run in the last two days returns alreadySent = 1 and writes nothing; the API then emails nobody. Serialised per run by an UPDLOCK on its HC.Event row.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Always exactly one row: the standard { Success, ErrorMessage } envelope, from the TRY on success or the CATCH on failure.

columns.name: Success
columns.description: 1 on success, 0 when the CATCH block ran.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: NULL on success; ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH block on failure.

columns.name: alreadySent
columns.description: 1 = this sendId was already recorded: nothing written, nothing should be sent. 0 = recorded now. Absent on an error.

columns.name: recipients
columns.description: The recipient count recorded for this send (the earlier one on a repeat).

sideEffects: @kind = 'send': UPDATE HC.Event SET EmailSendCount += 1, EmailLastSentAt = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET(), EmailLastSentCount = @recipientCount — fires the Event updatedAt trigger (row re-syncs).
@kind = 'send' AND @saveInstruction = 1: UPDATE HC.Kennel SET RunEmailInstruction (the Kennel trigger stamps updatedAt — the kennel row re-syncs).
Inserts one LOG.GeneralLog row (LogSource 'RunEmail') for every kind.

On any runtime error (including the two THROWs for missing inputs): rolls back if a transaction is open, inserts one HC.ErrorLog row (HcVersion '<api>', userId, eventId), returns the envelope with Success 0.
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
